audit_scope: Worker-4 source-reviewed database reconciliation over packet linked DBAASP, DRAMP, CAMP, and literature rows; conflicts are preserved rather than normalized.

caution_findings.evidence_context: DRAMP29087 activity/cytotoxicity/structure text is linked to this paper, but its sequence field is the 12-aa parent-like sequence rather than the paper RiLK1 decapeptide.
DBAASP cytotoxicity rows encode 0% cytotoxicity; local primary material supports no morphology alteration at 10 µM and BALB 3T3 viability, not that exact numeric endpoint for every listed cell line.
CAMP RiLK1 sequence/activity match local source; C-terminal NH2 is preserved as a database modification because local primary text does not explicitly restate RiLK1 termini.
